question: How does the timing of the Battle of Garibpur relate to the formal India-Pakistan war of December 1971?

options.text: It was fought weeks before the formal war began
It was fought after the formal war began, as part of the final advance
It was fought on the same day the formal war began

explanation: Garibpur was fought in November, weeks before the formal war began on 3 December, with Indian forces already engaging Pakistani positions on the road to Jessore.
